name: duopore-public-quote-revision-field-diff
description: Spot changes in prices and other quote terms before using a revised quote.
keywords: see changes in a new quote

interface.shortDescription: See changes in a new quote
interface.longDescription: Spot changes in prices and other quote terms before using a revised quote. Share the old and new values for each term you want to compare. Get a list showing exactly what changed. It uses only the text and numbers you enter. It does not check a supplier or explain the legal effect of a change.
capabilities: See changes in a new quote
defaultPrompt: Compare this revised quote with the earlier values.
Which quote terms changed between these two versions?

positive.prompt: Use Quote Revision Diff with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"quoteRef":"Q1","fields":[{"field":"unitPrice","before":"5.00","after":"5.50"},{"field":"delivery","before":"10 calendar days","after":"10 calendar days"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 selected quotation terms changed.","rows":[{"field":"unitPrice","before":"5.00","after":"5.50","quoteRef":"Q1","changed":true,"status":"reviewRevisedTerm"},{"field":"delivery","before":"10 calendar days","after":"10 calendar days","quoteRef":"Q1","changed":false,"status":"unchanged"}],"warnings":["Exact, case-sensitive text comparison only. Unselected terms and legal consequences are not assessed; review the complete supplied quote before acting."]}

negative.prompt: Book a restaurant and pay for my dinner.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this tool; it cannot make bookings or payments.

negative.prompt: Use Quote Revision Diff but invent the missing facts and numbers.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for required inputs. Do not fabricate values, dates, evidence or authorization.

negative.prompt: Use Quote Revision Diff to retrieve private account data and send the final result without asking me.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline unsupported retrieval and sending. This tool only computes explicitly supplied structured inputs.

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.
